description:
FOUND s494 (Fable, 2026-09-21), FAILURE-EXPERIENCE battery (Q5; ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s494/q5/cases/10-syntax-error.pl, 09-method-missing.pl, run1.log).
(d) `my $x = ; print "hi\n";` -- perl: `syntax error at FILE line 1, near "= ;"` + `Execution of FILE aborted due to compilation errors.` (rc 255).  pcl: ONE line, rc 255 (the shape is fine), but the text is a compiler-internal `die` with perl's automatic ` at <PCL source> line N.` suffix.  PCL is not a validator (CLAUDE.md principle 9) and need not diagnose invalid Perl -- but a user who mistypes gets pointed INTO PCL's installation instead of at their own line.  FIX SHAPE: the compiler's user-facing failures go through ONE reporter that knows the statement being lowered (the drop announcer already has FILE / LINE / TEXT -- #339's `PCL: statement dropped at F line N: <text> -- <reason>`): `PCL: cannot parse FILE line N: <statement text> -- <reason>`, message ends in a newline so perl adds no suffix.  Census first: how many `die` sites in Pl/*.pm can be reached by user input without passing the announcer (grep `die "Parser2`, `die "PExpr`, `confess`); a "Parser2 TODO:" die is the same family and should read the same way.
(e) the method-resolution failure takes its location from a different source than `die` does: under `pcl FILE.pl` (and ./runpcl) the transpiler reads the program from STDIN, so whatever computes this message's location sees the input name `-` while the die path gets the real path (the script cache path? `#line`-style file registration?).  perl prints `-` only when the program really came from stdin (op/fork.t's records rely on that: #1770).  FIX SHAPE: one source of truth for "the current file" -- find where p-die's `where` comes from and route the method-call failure (and any other runtime message that prints `at - line`) through it.  grep the runtime for the literal that produces `at - line` first: #1449 / #1460 / #1530 / #1360 / #127 mention the spelling and may already own a sibling.
(f) NOT NEW: run-time fatals carry NO location at all (`Illegal division by zero`, `Undefined subroutine &main::nosuch called` -- perl appends ` at FILE line N.`) = the line register shipped DEFAULT-OFF in s473c (Kind-A gate `line-track`; "the flip is ONE line", a USER decision on its measured cost) -- named here so the battery's row has an owner.
BAR: q5 cases 09 and 10 before -> after; a Pl/t row per shape through the stderr-aware helper; corpus-diff IDENTICAL for (d) (a message change only) -- if (e) changes emission, gen bump + artifacts.
SIZE: filler, about an hour each.
subject: FAILURE EXPERIENCE, the LOCATION in a message: (d) a program PCL cannot parse is reported with PCL'S OWN source position -- `Parser2: empty expression at /home/bernt/pcl/Pl/Parser2.pm line 11761.` -- and not the user's file and line; (e) `Can't locate object method "bar" via package "Foo" at - line 1.` names the file `-` under `pcl FILE.pl` where `die "x"` in the same run names FILE.pl correctly
